about: The packed calibration lane's naval arena (research/notes/modules/tasim-calibration.md, *The packed lane*): the generated map tools/tasim/synthmap.py builds (synthmap: naval), installed into each lane's game folder at its launch and hashed into the arena's (engrun.arena_sha256). Ground height 0 under sea level 75 -- the depth of the retail naval arena's water rectangle (tools/tasim/calib-arena-naval.json, Seven Islands), whose gravity and wind range it keeps -- and a dry plateau of height 85 over the corner region keepout, which holds the skirmish's start positions and the lane end's seat-1 unit (end) and in which tools/tasim/pack.py places no fight. flat is the water less the strips the engine's scroll extent leaves off (32 world units on x, 128 on y: the border mask 0x4833B0, engine/map.md). a, b and axis are the retail naval arena's: the fights are authored there and the packer translates each by a multiple of 128 world units. los, mapping, commander_death and unit_limit are the retail arena's.
